action.objective: Broad depth-4 search over all legal moves to find best continuation up a rook.
action.rationale: Up an exchange with connected rooks vs rook+pawn; need evidence to pick the strongest which avoids losing the b4/c3 pawns or exposing the king. Positions: Re8 rooks behind, h4 king safe, Black Rg6/h7 pawns. Cover all roots first.
